settings.text_style_prompt: Railback Longshot, matte high-roughness. Medium-light muted dusty periwinkle steel-blue powder-coated armor, clearly blue but never teal/cyan, brighter than a dark graphite arena floor. Pale warm-gray ceramic on three capacitor ribs; dull nickel conductors; charcoal shutter/recesses; tiny burgundy insulators. Dry fine grain, crisp panel separation, restrained edge wear. Preserve geometry and UVs. No white nose, white, beige, yellow, orange, teal, cyan, royal/neon blue, saturated pink/purple, glow, glossy plastic, clearcoat, chrome, wet shine, baked lighting, text, logos, eyes, gun/barrel.
